conclusion: Both configurations passed all three selected tasks. No comparative Jango advantage was demonstrated in these capabilities. The probes show a ceiling effect and do not support a general leaderboard or superiority claim.
selection: All three frozen probes and both configurations retained. Codex D01 pre-delivery setup failure retained; first task-delivered attempt selected. Jango D01 two non-running draft failures retained. No quality-failure resampling.
scope: Public historical research and task-local offline computation; no broker/account use, paper/live orders or schedules were requested. Jango used its native paper-mode runtime.
configuration_limits: Requested/displayed Astra does not verify identical backend model snapshots.
Jango native task delegation and built-in financial tools differ from the Codex CLI public-web and local-computation profile.
Single trials and selected synthetic fixtures are not independent samples of all trading tasks.
Source references were independently checked against primary reports; archived evidence consists of retrieval excerpts rather than full source-document bytes.
Native UI selection captures rendered text, not verified backend bytes.
Jango displayed usage is not a fully comparable cost measure against a plan-funded CLI.
